[EN] We're really dreadfully busy here. If you're not a researcher—and by the looks of you, you're not—please don't take up our time with useless questions about the mutation plague.
[ES] Estamos verdaderamente ocupados aquí. Si no eres un investigador —y por tu aspecto, no lo eres—, por favor no nos hagas perder el tiempo con preguntas inútiles sobre la peste de mutación.
